study type: Clinical, observational, transversal and controlled study
exposure: Presence and severity of urinary symptoms
presence and severity of urinary symptoms
Primiparous postpartum (vaginal delivery vs. cesarean section delivery)
cohort: 384 women in different phases of the female life cycle
finding: Pelvic floor muscle electromyographic activity decreases with age, parity, and the presence and severity of urinary symptoms.
mod_finding: Primigravid pregnant women, and both cesarean section and vaginal delivery groups, had higher electromyographic activity than the postmenopausal group.
